C_glc_init.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; glucose in the medium between food: a lean background, 0.1 mM (open-ocean dissolved glucose is nM-uM; placeholder). The cell is calibrated to just maintain itself here, so growth needs food

C_lac_init.data_reference: definitional; no lactate in the sea

C_H_init.data_reference: derived: free H+ = 10^-pH_o M (pH_o: halevy2017geologic, placeholder)

C_O2_init.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; dissolved O2 at about 1% of present atmospheric levels at 1.8 Ga (surface seawater at full air saturation holds about 0.28 mM at 20 C); range 0.1-10% PAL debated

C_mx_init.data_reference: definitional; no matrix until the cells make it

V_e.data_reference: geometry: cells of radius 1 um, 0.3 um apart on a triangular lattice, 2 um deep (R_cell, h_cell, colony_gap): triangle of side 2.3 um less three 60 degree sectors, x depth

b_H.data_reference: derived: beta_seawater / (ln 10 x free H+ at pH_o): bound per free H+ of a linear buffer (beta_seawater: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder; pH_o: halevy2017geologic, placeholder)

v_mx.data_reference: derived: M_glucose_unit x polysaccharide_specific_volume (M_glucose_unit: definitional, definitional; polysaccharide_specific_volume: amsden1998solute, placeholder)

k_mx.data_reference: zhang2003biodegradability; first-order breakdown of matrix by the colony's hydrolases (half-life about 8 days); EPS is biodegradable and used as a reserve in starvation (Zhang and Bishop 2003; Flemming and Wingender 2010), no rate found that applies

f_mx_glc.data_reference: zhang2003biodegradability; share of the broken-down matrix released as glucose in the volume; the rest is lost (oxidised or washed out)

C_mx_max.data_reference: derived: matrix_gel_density_max / M_glucose_unit (matrix_gel_density_max: flemming2010biofilm, placeholder; M_glucose_unit: definitional, definitional)

k_ovf.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; rate at which matrix above the densest gel leaves the volume (fast against production: the ceiling holds)
